Title: Rishabh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Ananya - 9 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Rajesh - 46 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
4. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh jumps with joy.]

Rishabh: "Mom, look at this."

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Anita: "Yes, all right."

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Rishabh (laughing): "Let's see."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Rishabh: "Really?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Rajesh: "So, here we are!"

[Ananya puts on red lipstick.]

Ananya: "What next?"

[Rishabh writes in his notebook.]

Ananya (laughing): "Okay, Rishabh."

[Rishabh talks to his father on the phone.]

Anita: "And then?"

[Rishabh's phone rings and he answers it.]

Rishabh (excited): "That's great!"

[Rishabh sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Rishabh: "I knew it!"

[Rishabh knocks on the door.]

Rajesh: "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

[Rishabh stands on the terrace. Anita and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh flies a kite on the terrace.]

Rajesh (softly): "This is amazing!"

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Rishabh stands in the bedroom. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh yawns loudly.]

Rishabh: "Okay, Mom."

[Rishabh stretches his arms above his head.]

Rishabh: "I really enjoyed today."
